title: The Eriksson Programme (Yang-Mills): Auditable Claim-to-Theorem Manifest, Certified Obstructions, and Continuation Frontier (Release yang-mills-archive-v1.0)
abstract: This archival technical note provides a self-contained, auditable claim-to-theorem specification and continuation handoff for the Yang-Mills Lean 4 formalization inside THE-ERIKSSON-PROGRAMME at archival release yang-mills-archive-v1.0 (commit 6b54eca695e96b3038ceda18276c4e28fb45983f; canonical Lean core checkpoint 02fae0ad, Lean v4.29.0-rc6, pinned mathlib 07642720480157414db592fa85b626dafb71355b). Responding to hostile assessments of v1 and v2, this v3 revision prints exact Lean 4 theorem statements and complete hypotheses (complex modulus and all four KP inequalities in the exact-action Wilson-loop area law, unspannable-chain behavior of chainAreaA, beta > 0 and literal definitions of SingleScaleUVDecay and covUV_concrete in the marginal RG conditional, unweighted Poincare predicate vs penalized coercivity and exact scale quantifiers, explicit transverse periodic Fourier witness A^(l) in ker Q_l for the flat Hodge factorized-penalty wall, explicit AmosBound inequality, and CompatibleLocalObservable thermodynamic-limit substrate), a declaration-level audit-coverage table distinguishing root oracle_check.lean (2,851 readouts across 46 imports), per-module oracles, and compiled-only modules, and a reconciled cross-reference of all 33 companion repository folders to their 33 live AIRR identifiers. No 4D continuum limit, physical SU(N) OS/Wightman reconstruction, or Clay Millennium Prize solution is claimed.

ai_assistance.statement: Large language models assisted manuscript preparation and Lean 4 formalization under author supervision. Core mathematical claims are verified by the Lean 4 kernel with standard axioms only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Independent frontier-model assessments are recorded separately in registry/model-assessments.json.

conflicts: The author owns and administers AIRR; no independent editorial admission is claimed.
editorial.statement: Working-paper version v3 supersedes v2. Declared major revision: v3 resolves all remaining gpt-6.2-sol objections on v2: adds literal Lean 4 signatures (complex modulus, four KP inequalities, chainAreaA unspannable-chain behavior), explicit beta > 0 and SingleScaleUVDecay/covUV_concrete definitions in the RG conditional, exact unweighted Poincare predicate vs penalized coercivity and scale quantifiers, explicit transverse periodic Fourier witness A^(l) in ker Q_l for flat Hodge obstructions, explicit AmosBound inequality and CompatibleLocalObservable substrate, a declaration-level oracle coverage table including check_oracle_output.py, explicit W = 2(F_a'F_b - F_aF_b') normalization, and reconciles Table 1 to 33 companion rows. It remains outside the AIRR accepted collection until this exact version passes review and receives a human decision.

technical_note.scope_statement: Auditable claim-to-theorem archival specification and continuation handoff for THE-ERIKSSON-PROGRAMME release yang-mills-archive-v1.0, quoting exact Lean 4 signatures, complete coupling/domain hypotheses, d=2 and d=4 strictly-interacting SU(2) thermodynamic-limit witnesses, exact obstruction classes, declaration-level oracle coverage, and all 33 companion live AIRR identifiers.
technical_note.limitations: This technical note proves no new theorem beyond synthesizing and auditing the verified Lean 4 core and companion records. It explicitly claims no 4D continuum limit (a -> 0), no physical SU(N) Osterwalder-Schrader or Wightman reconstruction, and no Clay Millennium Mass Gap solution; standalone R1/R2 cylinder modules and draft PR #29 remain outside YangMillsCore.
